2609.11916.title: Can Edge-Deployable Vision-Language Models Identify Species?
2609.11916.paper_summary: Camera traps often run in the field on edge hardware with limited or no connectivity, making small, locally-deployable vision-language models (VLMs) -- not frontier-scale ones -- the practically relevant class to evaluate for species identification. We test whether models in this deployment-relevant 2--8B range carry genuine taxonomic knowledge, evaluating four such VLMs (Qwen3-VL 2B/4B/8B, Gemma3 4B) against the domain-specific specialist BioCLIP (300M parameters) on a 96-species task, comparing clean iNaturalist photographs against camera-trap imagery from 6 LILA.science collections, on two independently-sampled evaluation sets. All models identify species far above chance, but every model -- general-purpose or specialist -- degrades sharply on field imagery (domain gaps of 9.6--26.6 percentage points, consistent across taxonomic levels and both evaluation sets), indicating the degradation reflects general image legibility rather than fine-grained discrimination failure. BioCLIP substantially outperforms every VLM tested (by 33.2--59.2 percentage points across an expanded 200-image sample for every model) despite its far smaller size, suggesting the gap reflects specialized training data rather than model scale; yet BioCLIP's own domain gap (18.0 points) is statistically indistinguishable from the best VLM's (22.3 points), suggesting the clean-to-field degradation itself is a property of the image-quality shift rather than a general-purpose-model weakness. Under open-set prompting, 5.9--9.6% of responses are syntactically valid but taxonomically nonexistent species names; the relative fabrication-rate ranking across models replicates exactly across both evaluation sets, a more robust finding than any single point estimate.
2609.11916.paper_summary_zh: 相機陷阱通常在邊緣硬體上運行，並且連接性有限或沒有連接，使得小型、本地可部署的視覺-語言模型（VLMs）——而非前沿規模的——成為評估物種識別的實際相關類別。我們測試這些部署相關的2--8B範圍內的模型是否具備真正的分類學知識，評估四種此類VLM（Qwen3-VL 2B/4B/8B，Gemma3 4B）與領域特定的專家BioCLIP（300M參數）在96種物種任務上的表現，將乾淨的iNaturalist照片與來自6個LILA.science收藏的相機陷阱影像進行比較，並在兩個獨立抽樣的評估集上進行。所有模型的物種識別率遠高於隨機，但每個模型——無論是通用型還是專家型——在現場影像上的表現急劇下降（分類學層級和兩個評估集中的領域差距為9.6--26.6個百分點），這表明下降反映的是一般影像可讀性，而非細粒度的區分失敗。儘管BioCLIP的規模遠小於每個測試的VLM，但其表現顯著優於所有測試的VLM（在擴展的200張影像樣本中，每個模型的差距為33.2--59.2個百分點），這表明差距反映的是專門的訓練數據，而非模型規模；然而，BioCLIP自身的領域差距（18.0個百分點）在統計上與最佳VLM的差距（22.3個百分點）無法區分，這表明從乾淨到現場的下降本身是影像質量變化的特性，而不是通用模型的弱點。在開放集提示下，5.9--9.6%的回應在語法上是有效的，但分類學上並不存在的物種名稱；跨模型的相對虛構率排名在兩個評估集上完全重複，這是一個比任何單一點估計更為穩健的發現。
